content:
Here are some cake options:

1. **2D CAKES**: 2D image imposed on top with any choice of cake. 2D Cartoon Drawing costs RS 150/- (Per Kg) plus the cost of the selected cake (Min 2 kg). Vanilla/Black Forest/White Forest (2Kg + 2D Charges) RS 1798/-. ![Image](http://staging.helpybo.com/media/products/Screenshot_2025-01-06_124712.png)

2. **JELLY BLACK FOREST**: Chocolate sponge cake soaked in sugar syrup, sandwiched with fresh cream chocolate, cherries & choco chip, topped with strawberry jello (Min 1 Kg). Price: ■899.00. ![Image](http://staging.helpybo.com/media/products/Screenshot_2025-01-06_123854.png)

3. **RAINBOW CAKE**: Vanilla sponge cake soaked in sugar syrup, sandwiched with fresh cream vanilla layered with food colors & topped with rainbow sprinkles (Min 1Kg). Making Time: 24 hrs. Price: ■1299.00. ![Image](http://staging.helpybo.com/media/products/Screenshot_2025-01-06_123929.png)

4. **HAZELNUT CHOCOLATE**: Chocolate sponge cake soaked in sugar syrup, sandwiched & topped with fresh cream chocolate, hazelnut choco spread & melted chocolate (Min 1Kg). Price: ■1099.00. ![Image](http://staging.helpybo.com/media/products/Screenshot_2025-01-06_124038.png)
